rawContent: I don't know what it's like to be a black man in this country, so I'm grateful for people sharing their horrifying reality with me.  It's up to white people to open our eyes, minds, and hearts and face this reality.  And then use our power to change things. #BlackLivesMatter

Say her name #BreonnaTaylor #BlackLivesMatter Time for white people to act not just cluck cluck tsk tsk what a shame. I’m writing to the @LMPD and other #Kentucky officials. Put my best white woman privilege to work for me here. Join me.
This is not just a series of protests, this is an uprising.  #BlackLivesMatter
